launch_blockers.title: Production database backup/protection
launch_blockers.current_state: Restore mechanics are proven, but the current Neon project cannot enable automatic backup scheduling or branch protection and has six-hour history retention.
launch_blockers.owner_decision: Choose either an eligible Neon capability/plan or an explicitly approved equivalent durable backup/protection design.

options.effect: Keep backup/restore control inside Neon and configure the approved Production RPO/protection target.
Implement and verify an independent durable backup/protection design with equivalent recovery objectives.

launch_blockers.title: Human alert delivery
launch_blockers.current_state: Telemetry, SLO rules, logs, and incident procedures are complete; no alert backend currently sends notifications to a person.
launch_blockers.owner_decision: Select/connect an alert-capable backend or explicitly defer alert delivery as a documented launch-risk acceptance.

options.effect: Use an eligible Vercel observability capability and activate the existing PG-OBS rules.
Connect an external observability/alert service and map the existing PG-OBS rules.
Launch without automated human alert delivery only if the project owner explicitly accepts the operational risk and records the temporary manual monitoring procedure.

engineering_summary: No decision-free remediation fix remains. The codebase is waiting on launch decisions/activations plus the optional deployed NHTSA proof.
go_rule: Do not mark Production GO until the Phase 10 preflight itself is refreshed to GO and explicit Production authorization is recorded.

recommended_defaults.rationale: Minimize new vendors and operational complexity while meeting the already-defined MVP launch controls.

details.reason: Protected branches are a Scale capability and Scale supports longer point-in-time restore windows. A seven-day window meets the current MVP recovery target without retaining more history than required initially.

PartGraph already emits structured custom operational events. Vercel Pro enables Drains, and Datadog can turn those drained logs into custom metrics/monitors, covering database readiness, provider ingestion, media reconciliation, and request/error events without new application instrumentation.
The policy and MVP merge gate are already tested and preserve the solo-maintainer workflow.
Already selected, plan-compatible, and integrated into the tested cutover choreography.
Production authorization must bind to one exact green candidate and one refreshed evidence package.

nhtsa_launch_disposition.reason: The feature/configuration is ready; only the stateful operator HTTP execution proof is missing, and it is not required to launch the validated MVP safely.
